notes: Scan 020 is an upright mathematical manuscript on blank printed institutional letterhead. The sheet_kind is text; Print is inventoried separately. The letterhead alone does not make it reused_typed.

Scan 020 upper right: dark encircled 3 is retained as manuscript pagination. The pale 19 at the lower-left edge is retained as a separate marginal/archival number; its attribution is not settled from this leaf.

All source text and graphic blocks were read in full. lines_read counts 18 physical non-diagram text/formula lines, including the three printed lines and the displaced replacement line; the handwritten numbers and every diagram label/row were also read and are separately inventoried. It is not a count of TeX output lines.

The full image and the two native overlapping halves were each observed once. Twenty-one distinct tight crops were made and successfully viewed. The initial p20 tool output was truncated; the same existing crop was then successfully viewed, without a new crop or renewed decision crop.

Scan 020 top: the extra thin curve beside p31 is independent of the three heavier inclusion curves. Its hooked return is preserved as graphic ink without assigning an extra map name or a mathematical role.

Scan 020 triangle: the p0sigma/Vert/p1 relation remains vertical. H horizontal equality is not present. The outline crossing the printed VAUCLUSE line is part of the surrounding diagram contour, not a strike through the print.
Scan 020 first product chain: q3 is decided from the oval left of a descending right stem, compared with p12 within the same arrow label. No inference from the expected projection family was used.

Scan 020 two product chains: paired arrowheads and actual relative placement of projection labels are preserved. Four separate surrounding strokes enclose only the initial portion of the second chain. The target outside the outline is not moved inside.

Scan 020 squares: the handwritten cart is transcribed as an author label. No assertion or proof of cartesianness was performed. In particular the upper square top connector, E3 square right endpoint and lower square left endpoint remain literal incomplete/rounded strokes, without supplying a conventional head from mathematical expectation.

Scan 020 point sketches: the cancelled left sketch has three upper and two lower points. Its thick crossing zigzag is a cancellation layer, not three independently legible maps. The right sketch has three upper and two lower points and deliberate gaps in all three outlines. The tiny sub-frame speck is not promoted to a sixth point.

Scan 020 dark strip: uncertainty concerns deletion state, independently of the clear point count and frame geometry. Retaining an explicitly uncertain deleted wrapper is not counted as a settled correction of H deletion state.

Scan 020 lower dual system: the tall S-shaped headless stroke is independent of the group glyph. The central X2 abrasion is paper damage, not an erased or deleted object. The top p12 in the circled square is retraced but no earlier cancelled index is inferred.

Scan 020 prose: the replacement word sits higher and to the right of the cancelled pts fixes; placement is recorded independently from its still unresolved reading. The initial cancelled E-like glyph and inclusion-like glyph remain uncertain; no unseen former letters or index are reconstructed.

Scan 020 bottom E1/E2 diagram: an isolated dark drop lies between the arrows, but has no clear aligned attachment or diagrammatic role. Following root review it is excluded as stray ink, not transcribed as a point, punctuation or extra object. The separate dots around the adjacent pen-test zigzag belong to that graphic pattern and are retained.

H editorial transitions, synopsis prose, cartesian-square heading, cart explanation and drawing descriptions are excluded as source text. Their failure to preserve a source diagram or their wrong point count is collated at the actual figure. Broad editorial notes do not qualify for marked_in_H=yes. Only the local ill/uncertain marks beside the cancelled inclusion and replacement passage qualify.

The supplied notation snapshot and the authorized root update from scan017 were used only as current reading guidance. The group family remains G/S and the inclusion family delta/partial; no other page or report was inspected for this assignment. Reordering unresolved group alternatives and adding local doubts alone are not counted as corrections of C.

No mathematical proof check, external research, OCR, text-recognition service, TeX compilation, upload or aggregate-file edit was performed. The diagram reconstructions use normal textual math labels, preserving uncertain letters as text; handwritten words were not replaced by pictures.

Reader: GPT-6 Astra Pro; effort not exposed; run SP93_C13_151, agent /root/reader_a. Root independently reviewed the original and all p01-p21 crops; remaining local reading uncertainties are retained for the second reading.
